newsitem.title: USA: SEC suspends trading in Genesis.
newsitem.headline: SEC suspends trading in Genesis.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said Thursday it suspended trading in Genesis International Financial Services Inc because of a lack of current and accurate information regarding its securities.
The trading suspension runs from 0930 EDT/1330 GMT on May 1 until 1159 EDT/1559 GMT on May 14, the commission said.
SEC said questions arose regarding the accuracy of assertions by Genesis, and by others, in documents and statements made to market-markers of the stock, other broker-dealers, and to investors.
Those assertions, among others, include the value of certain assets claimed by Genesis and the purported sale of a Genesis subsidiary, SEC said.
In February, Genesis reached an agreement in principal with an international investment group to sell its major operating unit CRIC for $117 million.
